title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 1
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q001_follow_through_on
elements.title: You promised to send the report, so please ___ on that promise.

elements.name: q002_dwindling
elements.title: Water supplies were ___ as the drought continued.

elements.name: q003_race_against_time
elements.title: With only an hour to find the lost keys before the last train, it was a ___.

elements.name: q004_put_something_to_bed
elements.title: The successful trial finally put the doubts ___ by showing that the design could work.

elements.name: q005_flashy
elements.title: The car's bright gold paint and oversized wheels looked ___.

elements.name: q006_take_aim_at_something
elements.title: The editorial ___ the council's decision, arguing that it wasted public money.

elements.name: q007_come_into_force
elements.title: The new parking rules will ___ on Monday, when officers begin enforcing them.

elements.name: q008_caveat
elements.title: The offer comes with one ___: it applies only to weekday bookings.

elements.name: q009_brag
elements.title: Which verb means to talk too proudly about your achievements?

elements.name: q010_taking_stock
elements.title: Before making another investment, we're ___ of what worked and what failed this year.
